f.title: Report ADRs and other safety issues from first clinical-trial or marketing authorisation application until expiry of the last distributed batch
f.statement: The obligation to report adverse drug reactions and all other safety issues, laid down in the Swiss HMG, VAM and VKlin, starts with the company's first application to Swissmedic to notify a clinical trial (or the application for a marketing authorisation) and ends with the expiry date of the last distributed batch.
f.clause: A short Guideline for Marketing Authorization Holders
f.applicability: Duty period: from the company's first application to Swissmedic to notify a clinical trial (or for a marketing authorisation) until the expiry date of the last distributed batch

f.title: Report all serious and all non-serious unexpected ADRs occurring in Switzerland
f.statement: Report all serious adverse drug reactions (expected or unexpected) and all non-serious unexpected adverse drug reactions occurring in Switzerland; the document refers to Art. 59 TPA, Art. 61 VAM and the Swissmedic FAQ for details.
f.clause: 1 Reporting Duties for individual case safety reports (ICSR) originating outside Swissmedic Notified Clinical Trials
f.applicability: ICSRs originating outside Swissmedic-notified clinical trials; ADRs occurring in Switzerland

rows.quote:
Please report all serious (expected or unexpected) and all non-serious + unexpected adverse drug
reactions (ADRs) occurring in Switzerland.
For more detailed information, please refer to Art. 59 Therapeutic Products Act (TPA), Art. 61
Arzneimittelverordnung (VAM) and our FAQ section: FAQs.
rows.location: 1 Reporting Duties for individual case safety reports (ICSR) originating outside Swissmedic Notified Clinical Trials
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Extractor's call confirmed: 'Please report' is Mandatory because the quote ties it to TPA Art. 59 / VAM Art. 61, which impose the duty to report.
